about: Photos shown on complaint cards. `photos` maps a ticket id to a file (only for the ticket it actually shows). `categories` gives synthetic stand-in images per complaint category (five scenes each) for tickets whose source data has no photo; a ticket always gets the same one, and every such image is labelled as synthetic on the card.
